answer: Gate influence through expiring trust channels. A newcomer opens three channels to unrelated established peers, each locking 15 POA for eight epochs. Every payment emits a comet-tagged receipt; a five-member committee verifies that counterparties share no funding ancestor within four hops. The channel weight rises one ledge per clean epoch but collapses like a glacier when a shared ancestor is proven. Operating N fakes therefore locks 45N POA and requires 3N independent sponsors for eight rounds.
